title: Federal Contract Momentum Pipeline Input
description: Pulls new federal contract awards (USAspending) for each company, measures momentum against the prior window, joins insider open-market buying (SEC Form 4), scores convergence 0 to 100, and tiers every company.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock tickers of the public contractors to scan, e.g. ["LDOS", "LMT", "BAH"]. The insider leg uses the ticker; the contract leg uses the recipient names below.

recipientNames.title: Recipient names (recommended)
recipientNames.description: Map of ticker to the USAspending recipient name(s) to search, e.g. {"LDOS": ["LEIDOS"], "LMT": ["LOCKHEED MARTIN"]}. USAspending lists legal entity names, which often differ from the brand. Provide one or more strings per ticker for accurate matching. If omitted, the company name (or ticker) is used.

companyNames.title: Company names (optional)
companyNames.description: Map of ticker to a human readable company name, e.g. {"LDOS": "Leidos"}. Used only to label output rows and as a fallback recipient search when no recipientNames entry is given.

recentWindowDays.title: Recent window (days)
recentWindowDays.description: Length of the recent award window. Momentum compares new awards in this window against an equal window immediately before it. 90 = last quarter vs the quarter before.

insiderLookbackDays.title: Insider lookback (days)
insiderLookbackDays.description: How far back to pull insider open-market buys and sells from SEC Form 4.

minNewAwardValueUsd.title: Minimum new award value (USD)
minNewAwardValueUsd.description: A company needs at least this much in new award dollars within the recent window to count as having contract momentum. Below it, contract momentum is treated as absent.

includeContracts.title: Include federal contracts
includeContracts.description: Pull federal contract awards from USAspending. Turn off to score on insider buying alone.

includeInsider.title: Include insider buying
includeInsider.description: Pull insider open-market buys and sells from SEC Form 4. Turn off to score on contract momentum alone.

minScore.title: Minimum convergence score
minScore.description: Drop and never charge companies scoring below this 0 to 100 threshold. 0 keeps every company with any signal.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. USAspending and EDGAR are public APIs that do not need a proxy, so the default is no proxy.
